verdict.rationale: The Sonar API reference shows responses carry a `citations` array of strings and a `search_results` array (the excerpt is truncated). The docs also promise built-in or inline citations and structured ranked search results, so source attribution data is clearly returned. The pack never shows which fields the results contain, so titles and published dates are not evidenced, and the citation strings are not confirmed to be canonical URLs. missing for 10: documented title field, documented published-date field, confirmation of canonical (non-redirect) URLs, independent or hands-on verification of citation metadata accuracy.
